run_postprocess_augmentations: run postprocess to apply image augmentations to view1 and view2 crops in a JAX batch
create_color_transform: create a color jitter and grayscale transform on a batch of NHWC images using JAX
apply_gaussian_blur: apply random gaussian blur to a batch of images with configurable sigma and kernel size
apply_solarize: apply solarization to a batch of images with a configurable threshold and apply probability
apply_random_flip: apply random left-right flip to a batch of images using JAX vmap
